violation_type.title: Required Admission Information - Potential complications (26 TAC §747.605(12)(B)(iii))
violation_type.typical_finding: One child with a special care need diagnosed by a doctor was missing the statement including the cognitive or mental condition that may warrant prevention or intervention while the child is in care. This was corrected at inspection when the designee/parent completed this section in the child's admission paperwork.
